CGY.head: The Flames have a hill to climb
CGY.body: Toronto has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Calgary has home-ice advantage. The Flames’ best way through is piling up shots.

TOR.head: Advantage, the Maple Leafs
TOR.body: Toronto has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Calgary has home-ice advantage. The Flames can make it interesting if they keep the shots coming.

story.head: The Maple Leafs come in hot
paras: The Flames have won three straight. The Maple Leafs have won four straight, the last a 7-2 rout of Edmonton.
The Flames shoot a lot, and the Maple Leafs give up plenty. Both teams like a fast game.

items.text: Auston Matthews is one point from 800.
Mikael Backlund has missed the Flames’ last two games.
